A+ Core 1 220-1201 Practice Test and Study Guide

APlus Academy Core 1 is a free A+ Core 1 220-1201 practice test and study guide course: forty-one lessons on mobile devices, networking, hardware, virtualization, cloud, and troubleshooting, a printable memorization sheet, tutorials built from your misses, and unlimited practice tests.

The exam at a glance

ExamCompTIA A+ Core 1
Code220-1201
Questions90
Time90 minutes
PassingThe real exam passes at 675 on a 100 to 900 scale. This course's official-format test uses 75%, that score divided by 900.
Course41 lessons across 9 units, about 6.7 hours of reading
CostFree

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 90 questions in 90 minutes, at its real passing score of 75%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

Every lesson, by unit

Questions people ask

How many questions are on the A+ Core 1 exam?

Up to 90 questions in 90 minutes, multiple choice and performance-based. The passing score is 675 on a scale of 100 to 900.

Do I need both A+ exams?

Yes. The A+ certification needs Core 1 (220-1201) and Core 2 (220-1202); this course covers Core 1 and its sister course covers Core 2.

How much does A+ cost?

See CompTIA's current voucher price for each exam; the course is free.

How does the course decide I am ready?

Three of your last five fifty-question practice tests at 80% or better, then one ninety-question test at the real passing score of 675 of 900.
